scope: Fresh-instance exploratory replication of full fixed-angle state compression: three 16-qubit five-city TSP instances and three 12-qubit uncapacitated fixed-two-vehicle routing instances with three customers. The latter degree QUBO is exactly equivalent to depot-connected routing only at this declared size. No capacitated-VRP or large-instance claim.
preparation: Fit a product prefix (L0) and native AQC-Tensor prefix (L2) to a 12-step half-anneal. One deterministic start each, same 60-second/120-iteration fitting caps. Initialize L2 by identity extension of fitted L0 plus fixed small perturbation. Independently optimize one QAOA layer for each prefix with 24 exact-energy COBYLA evaluations. Recompile each whole fixed-angle source into L2, initialized from its own prefix parameters. Exact verification of target MPS, fitted overlap, source circuit and physical compilation; no minimum fitted fidelity or outcome-based instance selection. All six cases retained. Any invalid case blocks the hardware batch for diagnosis.
hardware_design: Four methods per case: original AQC+QAOA, original product+QAOA, full AQC-source L2 and full product-source L2. Same patch within each family and matched full-compression gate budgets. Two randomized acquisition blocks; raw and gate-twirling+XX-DD arms, reverse arm order in block two. 32 twirls x 128 shots. Measurement twirling disabled. All-zero/all-one and four held-out mixed readout patterns per family in each raw block. Expected total 491520 shots, four jobs. No new hardware-dependent parameter refinement or case selection.
inference: Primary: two-sided Fisher comparisons of full AQC versus its original source, and full AQC versus matched full product, for feasible and within-5%-optimum events, in both arms and all six cases: one Holm family of 48 tests. Report all cases and raw counts/Clopper-Pearson intervals. Secondary block-stratified conditional exact tests, separately Holm-adjusted over the same 48 contrasts. Do not pool shots across instances as independent instance replication. Across-instance directional consistency is descriptive with only three instances per family.
mitigation: Local assignment-matrix inversion with physical measurement mapping and held-out marginal checks. Report signed corrected feasible/useful points, without clipping. Shared-calibration joint multinomial bootstrap for feasibility and matched feasibility contrasts only; require >=20 observed feasible events in every contributing row to publish its interval, otherwise mark insufficient support. No empirical-bootstrap useful-event intervals because rare unseen events invalidate that interpretation. Corrected events are estimands, not generated feasible samples.
